slices.name: AI Adoption and Usage Read Model
acceptanceCriteria: Module src/lib/tower/ai-adoption-usage.ts exports the canonical AI_TOOL_KEYS tuple ('github_copilot', 'claude_code', 'codex', 'cursor', 'servicenow_ai_agents', 'workday_ai_assistant', 'erp_agents_generic', 'salesforce_einstein', 'microsoft_copilot_m365', 'custom_internal_agents'), the AI_ADOPTION_HEALTH_STATES tuple ('not_started', 'piloting', 'partial_adoption', 'broad_adoption', 'declining', 'retired'), the AI_USAGE_VOLUME_BANDS tuple ('none', 'low', 'medium', 'high', 'very_high'), the AI_WORKFLOW_COVERAGE_STATUSES tuple ('not_covered', 'partial', 'fully_covered'), the AI_ADOPTION_GOVERNANCE_FLAGS tuple ('none', 'review_required', 'flagged'), the AiToolKey / AiAdoptionHealth / AiUsageVolumeBand / AiWorkflowCoverageStatus / AiAdoptionGovernanceFlag enum types, AiToolAdoptionRecord, AiAdoptionUsageSummary, and the helpers buildAiAdoptionUsageInventory, summarizeAiAdoptionUsage, getAiAdoptionByTool, getDecliningOrRetiredTools, and getUngovernedAdoption.

buildAiAdoptionUsageInventory returns at least 18 deterministic seed records, with at least 1 record per canonical tool (10 tools), at least 1 record per canonical health state (6 states), and at least 6 distinct business functions.

Every record carries at least 1 workflow covered; every record's adoptionRate equals activeUsers / potentialUsers (rounded to 4 decimals); every record carries createdFrom 'deterministic_ai_adoption_seed'; every record id matches the canonical 'ai-adopt-seed-{tool}-{n}' shape and ids are unique; activeUsers and potentialUsers are non-negative integers with active <= potential.
At least 2 records carry governanceFlag 'flagged'.

summarizeAiAdoptionUsage reconciles totals (byTool, byHealth, and byUsageVolume sum to totalRecords), exposes every canonical tool / health / usage-band key (zero allowed), reports totalActiveUsers and totalPotentialUsers that agree with their defining sums, and returns uniqueBusinessFunctions and uniqueWorkflows sorted ascending and de-duplicated.

getAiAdoptionByTool returns only records matching the requested tool; getDecliningOrRetiredTools returns exactly the records whose adoptionHealth is 'declining' or 'retired'; getUngovernedAdoption returns exactly the records whose governanceFlag is 'review_required' or 'flagged'.

Seed contains no invented dollar amounts (regex \$\s*\d on JSON.stringify), no banned placeholder language ('Coming soon' / 'TBD' / 'Lorem ipsum'), and no endorsement-style framing ('recommended tool' / 'best-in-class' / 'industry leader' / 'we endorse' / 'our preferred' / 'guaranteed roi'); vendor names appear only as toolName / tool keys, never as recommendations; module source has no imports from src/lib/source / sentinel / atlas / nexus / agent / auth or supabase, and no Date.now / Math.random / new Date( / fetch( / anthropic / openai / useState / useEffect.

slices.name: AI Value / Outcome Ledger Read Model

buildAiValueOutcomeLedger returns at least 16 deterministic seed entries with at least one entry per canonical category and at least one entry per canonical readiness state.

At least 4 entries carry realizedValue !== null with non-null computed varianceAbs and variancePercent; at least 2 entries carry governanceReviewStatus 'flagged'; at least 2 entries link a canonical programKey from mock.ts (contact-center-ai / unified-customer-data-platform / store-associate-productivity / demand-forecasting-ai); at least 2 entries link a canonical aiUseCaseKey of the form 'ai-use-case-seed-{n}'.

Every entry carries seed_value: true and createdFrom 'deterministic_value_outcome_ledger_seed'; every id matches the 'value-seed-{n}' shape and ids are unique; every dollar-denominated entry uses the 'usd_seed' measurement unit; linked claim ids use the canonical 'claim-seed-' prefix.

summarizeAiValueOutcomeLedger reconciles totals (byCategory, byReadiness, and byMeasurementUnit sum to totalEntries), exposes every canonical category / readiness / measurement-unit key (zero allowed), reports measuredCount as the sum of measured_in_pilot and measured_in_production rows, projectedOnlyCount equal to byReadiness.projected_only, flaggedGovernanceCount that agrees with the defining filter, and uniqueInitiatives sorted ascending and de-duplicated.

computeVariance returns null fields when realizedValue is null; returns realized - projected for varianceAbs and ((realized - projected) / projected) * 100 for variancePercent; returns null variancePercent when projectedValue is 0 and realizedValue is non-zero; returns 0 when both are 0; matches the precomputed seed varianceAbs / variancePercent fields field-by-field.

Seed contains no invented dollar amounts (regex \$\s*\d on JSON.stringify), no branded vendor endorsements (deny-list OpenAI / Anthropic / Cohere / Mistral / Databricks / Snowflake / Microsoft Copilot / GitHub Copilot), and no banned placeholder language (Coming soon / TBD / Lorem ipsum); module source has no imports from src/lib/source / sentinel / atlas / nexus / agent / auth or supabase, and no Date.now / Math.random / new Date( / fetch( / anthropic / openai / useState / useEffect.

buildProductivityDoraEntries returns at least 20 deterministic seed entries; all 4 DORA metrics and all 6 productivity metrics are covered with at least 1 entry each; all 4 bands (elite, high, medium, low) and all 4 trends (improving, flat, declining, unknown) are present with at least 1 entry each; at least 3 entries are declining; at least 5 unique team labels are present.

Every entry carries liveTelemetry: false and createdFrom 'deterministic_productivity_dora_seed'; every entry's measurementSource is one of 'seed_only', 'manual_capture', 'gh_actions_seed', 'jira_seed', or 'incident_report_seed'; every entry id matches the canonical 'dora-seed-{team}-{metric}' shape and ids are unique; every entry has at least one non-empty note; delta equals currentValue minus baselineValue.

summarizeProductivityDora reconciles totals (byBand and byTrend sum to totalEntries; doraCount + productivityCount equals totalEntries), exposes every canonical band and trend key (zero allowed), reports byMetric counts that sum to totalEntries and expose every metric present in the input, and returns uniqueTeams and uniquePrograms sorted ascending and de-duplicated.

getDoraEntries and getProductivityEntries partition the input by metricKind; getDecliningOrLowBandEntries returns only entries whose trend is 'declining' or whose band is 'low' and excludes entries that are improving and not in the low band; helpers default to summarizing the canonical seed when called with no arguments.

Seed contains no invented dollar amounts (regex \$\s*\d on JSON.stringify), no branded vendor endorsements (deny-list OpenAI / Anthropic / Cohere / Mistral / Databricks / Snowflake / Microsoft Copilot / GitHub Copilot), no banned placeholder language (Coming soon / TBD / Lorem ipsum), and no positive live-telemetry claims; module source has no imports from src/lib/source / sentinel / atlas / nexus / agent / auth or supabase, and no Date.now / Math.random / new Date( / fetch( / anthropic / openai / useState / useEffect.
